resources.string: Make another parent an admin. If this phone is lost, an admin is needed to invite phones again; without one the family has to create a new group.
Admins can invite and remove phones. This cannot be undone without pairing that phone again.
The phone stops syncing with the group. To come back it needs a new invitation and a reset of its identity.

Everyone in the group will be told that this phone left. The group\'s data on this phone will be deleted. Data already on their phones stays until their retention ends. Coming back needs a new invitation.
You are the only admin. Make another parent an admin first, or remove the other phones.
This phone is not in a family group.
Not in the group any more
This phone was removed from the family group or has left it.
This phone is no longer an active member of a family group, so there is nothing to leave.
Leaving was refused: other phones are still in the group and this phone is their only admin. Make another parent an admin, or remove the other phones, then leave.
Could not record that this phone is leaving. Nothing was deleted; try again.
Your family was told that this phone left, but clearing this phone failed. Tap Start over to finish.
Could not make this member an admin.
